title: Third Anniversary: IDF Struck Over 100,000 Targets in Gaza, 31,500 Projectiles Fired at Israel
detail: On the third anniversary of the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack, compiled data shows the IDF struck more than 100,000 targets across Gaza over the course of the conflict, while Palestinian armed groups fired over 31,500 projectiles at Israeli territory during the same period. The figures, released on Day 1096, underscore the scale of the three-year military campaign — the longest sustained Israeli military operation in Gaza since 1948. The cumulative death toll in Gaza stands at over 73,900 since the conflict began.

title: AI-Driven Targeting Systems Have Transformed the Gaza Battlefield Over Three Years
detail: An analysis published on the third anniversary of the conflict examines how AI-driven targeting systems have fundamentally changed the nature of military operations in Gaza. The systems, which include automated target identification and strike-recommendation platforms, have been credited by the IDF with enabling the high volume of strikes — over 100,000 targets hit over three years. Critics and human rights groups argue the same systems have contributed to high civilian casualty rates, citing AI-assisted targeting in densely populated areas. The analysis marks a significant inflection point in the use of artificial intelligence in modern urban warfare.

title: Israeli Forces Kill at Least Four Palestinians Across Gaza and West Bank on Third Anniversary of Oct 7
detail: On the third anniversary of the October 7, 2023 Hamas attacks, Israeli forces killed at least four Palestinians across Gaza and the West Bank. The killings occurred amid commemorations of the attacks that triggered the conflict now entering its fourth year. The deaths mark the continuation of near-daily Israeli military operations in both territories, despite the nominal ceasefire in place since October 2025. The anniversary saw heightened tensions across the region as Israel and Palestinian factions marked the milestone with competing narratives about the war's toll and trajectory.

media.caption: Palestinians mourn amid Israeli strikes on the third anniversary of the October 7 attacks
